title: Mouse without Borders" is not working. I am unable to create key, configure, or establish a connection.

comment.body:
Thanks for identifying PowerToys 0.102.3001 and the key-creation failure. To distinguish the SettingsSync failure tracked in #50795 from a separate process/clipboard problem:

1. State the action immediately before the failure (enable MWB, open Settings, New key, connect, or Use Service).
2. Reproduce once, comment `/bugreport`, and attach the newly generated ZIP immediately afterward.

Please omit pairing keys and device identities from screenshots.
